About Flagyl

Flagyl Suspension 200mg/5ml: Metronidazole benzoate (200mg/5ml), made by Sanofi. Diarrhoea and dysentery caused by infection in children, as prescribed.

This is a prescription medicine. Use it only as prescribed by your doctor. We will ask for a valid prescription before supplying it — you can send a photo on WhatsApp.

A child's dose depends on age and weight. Please ask our doctor or pharmacist before giving it to your child.

This information is for general awareness only. Always read the leaflet and follow the advice of your doctor or pharmacist.
